subject: Black coral
topic: This tree-like coral may belong to one of the oldest living things on Earth.
script:
This tree-like coral may belong to one of the oldest living things on Earth.
It's a black coral, from a group known for its extreme old age.
Black corals are named for their dark skeletons, even though the living coral can be white, orange or red.
Some colonies from this group have been dated at more than four thousand years old.
They were already growing thousands of years before the Roman Empire.
They grow incredibly slowly, only a tiny fraction of a millimeter each year.
Deep, cold, calm water lets them survive that long.
This one was filmed by NOAA off the southeastern United States, in twenty nineteen.
Damaging one could erase thousands of years of growth in seconds.
How old do you think this one is?
pkg_title: This Coral Group Can Live Over 4,000 YEARS 🤯 #Shorts
